name: Customizable Fully Parametric Dog / Cat Food Bowl

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a sturdy, low-profile pet bowl with a conical exterior. The outer walls slope inward from a wide base to a narrower top rim, providing high stability against tipping. The interior of the bowl is a smooth, hemispherical depression, surrounded by a thick, flat-topped rim.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, tip-resistant pet bowl with a conical outer profile and a hemispherical interior cavity. The user should be able to customize the bottom and top outer diameters, total height, wall thickness, interior bowl diameter, and optionally wrap custom text around the exterior wall using an external write library.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main 'bowl' module. It starts with a base cylinder that has different bottom and top radii to form the outer cone shape. It uses an external 'writecylinder' module to wrap text around this cone, intersecting the text with a slightly larger cone for a clean finish. The interior is hollowed out by differencing a translated cone (representing the wall thickness offset) and a scaled sphere to create the smooth hemispherical bowl cavity.
